Throne speech and parliament opening framed as institutional continuity
New parliament speaker elected; routine institutional transition

summary.en: Jordan's news over the period is mostly positive: an IMF staff-level deal on the sixth review that could unlock about $294 million, and a Jordanian judge re-elected to the International Court of Justice. The Karak church attack is handled through terrorism charges and a state security court referral, which is a routine institutional response rather than a crisis.

en: IMF staff-level deal on sixth review unlocking $294M
Jordanian judge re-elected to International Court of Justice
Karak church attack suspects charged and referred to trial

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: throne speech follow-up coverage, water policy debate, and cultural and diplomatic items. The IMF staff-level agreement unlocking $294m is a clear positive, offset by a condemned criminal attack in Karak and reports of divisions in parliamentary alliances.

en: IMF staff-level agreement on reviews, paving way for $294m
Salt museum registered on ALECSO heritage list
Condemned criminal act in Karak with reported casualties

summary.en: A deadly stabbing attack killed a security officer in Amman and was followed by condemnations and calls for national unity, with a Karak attack also referenced. Otherwise the period looks ordinary, with routine investment, social security and agricultural news, so the score sits somewhat below a typical day.

en: Terror stabbing attack killed a security officer in Amman
Widespread condemnations and public solidarity with the security services
Routine economic news: new factory investment and social security expansion

summary.en: A deadly stabbing attack in Amman killed a security officer, prompting overnight security raids and arrests, and the government vowed to continue the fight against terrorism. Coverage shows a unified public response and a commitment to tougher laws, but the incident is isolated and there is no wider unrest.

en: Deadly terrorist stabbing attack in Amman killed a security officer
Overnight security raids and arrests after the attack
Public unity and funeral gatherings; calls for tougher anti-terror laws

summary.en: The period is dominated by security concerns: a deadly attack that killed a security figure, a church incident, the foreign trial of recent security cases, and interceptions of weapons smuggling. Institutions remain functional, with a throne speech, a 2027 budget and investment diplomacy, so the picture is serious but not a crisis of state.

en: Deadly attack and mourning for a slain security figure (Salayta)
Weapons smuggling via balloons intercepted; extremism and border threats debated
Throne speech and 2027 budget signal routine institutional continuity

summary.en: The period is dominated by mourning after a deadly terrorist attack in Hamoud that killed nine people, followed by another death (Jawad Slayteh), and by the trial of the attackers. The state response is institutional: officials pledge unity against terrorism, and tougher counter-terrorism penalties are reported, which keeps the score in the serious-problems band rather than a crisis.
summary.ja: この期間は、ハムードで発生した死者9人を出したテロ攻撃と、その後のジャワド・スライテー氏の死亡、そして襲撃犯の裁判によって、哀悼の空気に包まれている。国の対応は制度的なもので、当局はテロに対する結束を誓い、テロ対策の罰則強化も報じられている。これにより、スコアは危機ではなく「深刻な問題」の区分にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 하무드에서 9명이 숨진 치명적 테러 공격과 그 뒤 발생한 또 다른 사망자(자와드 슬라이테)에 대한 애도, 그리고 공격자들에 대한 재판이 주를 이룬다. 국가의 대응은 제도적 차원에서 이루어져, 관료들은 테러에 맞서 단결을 다짐하고 있으며 테러 대응 처벌 강화도 보도되고 있다. 이에 따라 점수는 위기가 아닌 '심각한 문제' 범주에 머물러 있다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में हमूद में हुए एक घातक आतंकवादी हमले में नौ लोगों की मौत और उसके बाद जवाद स्लायटेह की मौत पर शोक, तथा हमलावरों के मुकदमे का वर्चस्व रहा है। राज्य की प्रतिक्रिया संस्थागत है: अधिकारियों ने आतंकवाद के खिलाफ एकजुटता की प्रतिज्ञा की है और आतंकवाद-रोधी सख्त दंड की खबरें हैं, जिससे स्कोर संकट के बजाय गंभीर समस्याओं की श्रेणी में बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από τη θλίψη μετά από μια θανατηφόρα τρομοκρατική επίθεση στη Χαμούντ, που σκότωσε εννέα ανθρώπους, ακολουθούμενη από έναν ακόμη θάνατο (Τζαβάντ Σλαϊτέχ), και από τη δίκη των δραστών. Η κρατική απάντηση είναι θεσμική: οι αξιωματούχοι δεσμεύονται για ενότητα κατά της τρομοκρατίας και αναφέρονται αυστηρότερες ποινές αντιτρομοκρατικής νομοθεσίας, γεγονός που κρατά τη βαθμολογία στη ζώνη σοβαρών προβλημάτων και όχι στην κρίση.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dal lutto per un attentato terroristico mortale a Hamoud, che ha ucciso nove persone, seguito da un'altra morte (Jawad Slayteh) e dal processo contro gli autori. La risposta dello Stato è istituzionale: i funzionari promettono unità contro il terrorismo e si segnalano pene più severe per il contrasto al terrorismo, il che mantiene il punteggio nella fascia dei problemi gravi piuttosto che in quella di crisi.
summary.ru: Период определяется траурем после смертоносной террористической атаки в Хамуде, в результате которой погибли девять человек, а также ещё одной гибелью (Джавад Слайте) и судебным процессом над нападавшими. Ответ государства носит институциональный характер: официальные лица обещают единство в борьбе с терроризмом, сообщается об ужесточении наказаний за терроризм, что удерживает оценку в диапазоне серьёзных проблем, а не кризиса.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة مشاعر الحداد بعد هجوم إرهابي دامٍ في حمود أودى بحياة تسعة أشخاص، تلاه مقتل شخص آخر (جواد سلايطة)، ومحاكمة المهاجمين. ورد الدولة مؤسسي: يتعهد المسؤولون بالوحدة في مواجهة الإرهاب، ويُذكر فرض عقوبات أشد لمكافحة الإرهاب، مما يُبقي التقييم ضمن فئة المشكلات الخطيرة لا الأزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر سوگ پس از یک حمله تروریستی مرگبار در حمود است که نُه نفر را کشت، و همچنین مرگ فرد دیگری (جواد سلایطه) و محاکمه عاملان حمله. واکنش دولت نهادی است: مقامات بر اتحاد در برابر تروریسم تأکید می‌کنند و از تشدید مجازات‌های مقابله با تروریسم خبر داده می‌شود، که امتیاز را در سطح مشکلات جدی نگه می‌دارد نه بحران.
summary.zh: 本时期主要围绕哈穆德发生的一起致九人死亡的恐怖袭击的哀悼，此后又有一人死亡（贾瓦德·斯莱特），以及袭击者的审判。国家的应对是制度性的：官员承诺团结反恐，并有报道称将加重反恐处罚，这使该评分保持在严重问题区间，而非危机。
summary.tr: Dönem, Hamoud'da dokuz kişinin ölümüne yol açan terör saldırısının ve ardından bir başka adamın (Jawad Slayteh) ölümünün yarattığı yas ile saldırganların yargılanması tarafından belirleniyor. Devlet tepkisi kurumsal nitelikte: yetkililer terörizme karşı birlik çağrısı yapıyor ve terörle mücadele cezalarının sertleştirildiği bildiriliyor. Bu nedenle skor, bir kriz değil ciddi sorunlar bandında kalıyor.
summary.es: El período está dominado por el duelo tras un atentado terrorista en Hamoud que causó nueve muertos, seguido de otra muerte (Jawad Slayteh), y por el juicio contra los autores del ataque. La respuesta estatal es institucional: los funcionarios se comprometen a la unidad contra el terrorismo y se informa de penas más duras para la lucha antiterrorista, lo que mantiene la puntuación en la franja de problemas graves y no de crisis.
summary.fr: La période est marquée par le deuil après un attentat terroriste meurtrier à Hamoud, qui a fait neuf morts, suivi d'un autre décès (Jawad Slayteh), ainsi que par le procès des auteurs de l'attaque. La réponse de l'État est institutionnelle : les responsables promettent l'unité face au terrorisme et des peines plus sévères en matière de lutte antiterroriste sont signalées, ce qui maintient le score dans la catégorie des problèmes graves plutôt que dans celle de la crise.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird von der Trauer nach einem tödlichen Terroranschlag in Hamoud mit neun Toten und einem weiteren Todesfall (Jawad Slayteh) sowie vom Prozess gegen die Attentäter bestimmt. Die staatliche Reaktion ist institutioneller Natur: Amtsträger geloben Einigkeit im Kampf gegen den Terrorismus, und es werden verschärfte Strafen für Terrorismusdelikte gemeldet, wodurch der Wert im Bereich ernster Probleme und nicht in dem einer Krise verbleibt.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pelo luto após um ataque terrorista mortal em Hamoud, que matou nove pessoas, seguido de outra morte (Jawad Slayteh), e pelo julgamento dos autores do ataque. A resposta do Estado é institucional: autoridades prometem unidade contra o terrorismo e são noticiadas penas mais severas para o combate ao terrorismo, o que mantém a pontuação na faixa de problemas graves, e não de crise.

en: Deadly terrorist attack in Hamoud killing nine people and another man
Trial of church attack perpetrators proceeding through court sessions
Government and parliament pledge unity; tougher terrorism penalties cited
ja: ハムードでの致命的なテロ攻撃により9人ともう1人の男性が死亡
教会襲撃の実行犯の裁判が法廷審理を通じて進行中
政府と議会が結束を表明し、テロ罰則の強化が言及される
ko: 하무드에서 발생한 치명적 테러 공격으로 9명과 또 다른 남성 1명이 사망
교회 공격 가해자들에 대한 재판이 법정 심리를 통해 진행 중
정부와 의회가 단결을 약속하며, 테러 처벌 강화가 언급됨
hi: हमूद में घातक आतंकवादी हमला, जिसमें नौ लोग और एक अन्य व्यक्ति मारे गए
चर्च हमले के अपराधियों का मुकदमा अदालती सुनवाइयों के माध्यम से जारी
सरकार और संसद ने एकजुटता का संकल्प लिया; सख्त आतंकवाद-रोधी दंड का उल्लेख
el: Θανατηφόρα τρομοκρατική επίθεση στη Χαμούντ που σκότωσε εννέα ανθρώπους και έναν ακόμη άνδρα
Δίκη των δραστών της επίθεσης στην εκκλησία σε εξέλιξη μέσω δικαστικών συνεδριάσεων
Κυβέρνηση και βουλή δεσμεύονται για ενότητα· αναφέρονται αυστηρότερες ποινές για την τρομοκρατία
it: Attentato terroristico mortale a Hamoud che ha ucciso nove persone e un altro uomo
Processo agli autori dell'attacco alla chiesa in corso con udienze in tribunale
Governo e parlamento promettono unità; citate pene più severe per il terrorismo
ru: Смертоносная террористическая атака в Хамуде, унёсшая жизни девяти человек и ещё одного мужчины
Судебный процесс над исполнителями нападения на церковь продолжается в ходе судебных заседаний
Правительство и парламент обещают единство; упоминаются более строгие наказания за терроризм
ar: هجوم إرهابي دامٍ في حمود أودى بحياة تسعة أشخاص ورجل آخر
محاكمة مرتكبي الهجوم على الكنيسة مستمرة عبر جلسات المحكمة
الحكومة والبرلمان يتعهدان بالوحدة؛ ويُذكر تشديد عقوبات الإرهاب
fa: حمله تروریستی مرگبار در حمود که نُه نفر و مرد دیگری را کشت
محاکمه عاملان حمله به کلیسا در جلسات دادگاه ادامه دارد
دولت و پارلمان بر اتحاد تأکید می‌کنند؛ از مجازات‌های سخت‌تر تروریسم یاد شده است
zh: 哈穆德发生恐怖袭击，造成九人及另一名男子死亡
教堂袭击案的肇事者审判正在法庭开庭审理
政府和议会承诺团结；提及将加重恐怖主义处罚
tr: Hamoud'da dokuz kişiyi ve bir başka adamı öldüren terör saldırısı
Kilise saldırısının faillerinin mahkeme oturumları aracılığıyla süren yargılanması
Hükümet ve meclis birlik taahhüdü veriyor; terörle mücadele cezalarının sertleştirildiği belirtiliyor
es: Atentado terrorista mortal en Hamoud que causó la muerte de nueve personas y de otro hombre
Juicio contra los autores del ataque a la iglesia, en curso mediante sesiones judiciales
El Gobierno y el parlamento se comprometen a la unidad; se citan penas más severas contra el terrorismo
fr: Attentat terroriste meurtrier à Hamoud ayant tué neuf personnes et un autre homme
Procès des auteurs de l'attaque contre une église, en cours d'audiences judiciaires
Le gouvernement et le parlement promettent l'unité ; des peines plus sévères contre le terrorisme sont évoquées
de: Tödlicher Terroranschlag in Hamoud mit neun Toten und einem weiteren Mann
Prozess gegen die Täter des Kirchenangriffs, der in Gerichtsverhandlungen voranschreitet
Regierung und Parlament geloben Einigkeit; verschärfte Strafen für Terrorismus werden genannt
pt: Ataque terrorista mortal em Hamoud que matou nove pessoas e outro homem
Julgamento dos autores do ataque à igreja, em andamento nas sessões do tribunal
Governo e parlamento prometem unidade; cita-se o endurecimento das penas para o terrorismo

summary.en: The country faces a very large Ebola outbreak (9,415 confirmed cases, over 4,500 deaths, spread to 8 provinces, spillover into neighboring Kenya). In addition, armed violence and displacement in the east (Djugu, Rutshuru), cholera-like diarrhoea deaths in North Kivu, the Kabila-led rebel movement and tensions with the government stand out. Payment problems for response teams, actions halting economic activity and protests further aggravate the situation; small positive developments such as school reopenings cannot offset it.

en: Ebola outbreak: 9,415 cases, ~4,500+ deaths, spread to an 8th province, unvaccinated strain
Armed violence and mass displacement in the east (Djugu 24,600; Rutshuru 70,000 without aid)
Kabila's rebel movement and political polarization/uncertainty over dialogue
Cholera-like diarrhoea outbreak in North Kivu and payment crisis for Ebola response staff
Miner protests in Kolwezi, 'Stop Ebola' day and shutdown in Beni, and tax-related reactions

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a spreading Ebola outbreak with a record caseload, fighting and health-system disruption in North Kivu, and an African Union warning against seizure of power by force amid a political and security crisis. Some positives, such as the National Assembly passing development financing, the school reopening in Inongo and the census going smoothly, do not offset these.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading, with more cases in North Kivu than Ituri
AU warns against seizure of power by force amid political crisis
Fighting in North Kivu leaves only 11 of 22 health zones working

summary.en: The DRC faces a severe Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread, renewed hostilities that have forced thousands to flee in the southeast, and a new rebel alliance. Local protests in Kolwezi are calming, but food prices are rising and political tensions are high.

en: Ebola outbreak rebounds, nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread
Thousands flee escalating hostilities in southeastern DRC
New rebel alliance and FDLR-related conflict coverage

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 DRC cases, ADF and CODECO massacres and hostage killings in the east, and a political rift between Tshisekedi and Kabila. Together these point to serious humanitarian and security strain, with no offsetting peace or recovery signal.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases, spreading to Nigeria and health workers infected
77 civilians killed by ADF in Mambasa; over 80,000 displaced
Two hostages killed after CODECO abduction in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak, with deaths near 4,700 and cases in an eighth province, partly offset by the start of a vaccine trial. Domestic politics also show strain, including arrests of political figures and a no-confidence motion.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 4,700 deaths and spreading to eighth province
Start of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trial in Bunia
Arrests of opposition figure and UDPS cadre; no-confidence motion against minister

summary.en: The period mixes a major Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain), with Uganda restricting transit and Ebola response workers striking over unpaid bonuses, against a positive step in the launch of a vaccine trial. Political and security stress also shows up in more than 100 detentions in Lubumbashi, protests in Kisangani, and no-confidence motions in Tshuapa and Kinshasa.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading cross-border; Uganda restricts DRC-linked travellers
Launch of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine clinical trial in Bunia
Over 100 people detained in Lubumbashi security operations

summary.en: The period is dominated by an expanding Ebola outbreak, including a nurse killed over Ebola rumours and new Ugandan travel restrictions, alongside a constitutional referendum dispute and security-force violence against protesters and Catholic worshippers. Some positives, such as Ebola recoveries and FARDC operations against ADF, do not offset the serious problems.

en: Nurse killed in Bafwasende over Ebola rumours; health workers attacked
Uganda imposes travel restrictions and 21-day quarantine on DRC travellers
Security forces reportedly fire on Catholic faithful; Kolwezi unrest with 58 arrests

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak with attacks on health workers, including a nurse killed, and deadly CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Political strain is also visible in a contested referendum law, a provincial governor's removal, and Kolwezi protests. Positive signals such as a vaccine trial, infrastructure launches and a youth peace festival do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases with attacks on health workers
CODECO attacks in Djugu killing more than a dozen people
Referendum law adoption and Senate opposition

summary.en: The period is dominated by an Ebola outbreak that passed 10,000 cases, with 1,424 deaths reported in North Kivu and a treatment centre overwhelmed, plus armed clashes in South Kivu and CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Modest positives, such as recoveries, a solar plant inauguration and a vaccine trial, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases; 1,424 deaths in North Kivu
Treatment centre in Beni overwhelmed; nurse killed by mob
FARDC–FRN clashes in Fizi and Walungu; CODECO attacks in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a record Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases), renewed fighting around Uvira and Walikale with new displacements, and drone strikes linked to the Kabila-aligned FRN. Some positives, such as no new Ebola cases at Mongbwalu, rebel surrenders in Fizi and calm returning to Lodja, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases, concentrated in Ituri
Fighting around Uvira and renewed displacement in Walikale
Kabila-aligned FRN rebels and drone strike allegations

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, 4,900 deaths reported) and renewed fighting in the east that is displacing civilians and disrupting relief. Partial positives include a vaccine trial, a fighter surrender in Fizi, and US sanctions on Rwanda that Kinshasa welcomed, but they do not offset the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,900 deaths
Renewed fighting in Ituri and Walikale displaces thousands of civilians
464 human rights violations documented in July by BCNUDH

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic in the east, with over 10,000 cases and a death toll near 5,000, alongside ongoing armed attacks, M23/FRN fighting and ADF activity. Positive news, such as exiting the FATF grey list, is outweighed by these serious humanitarian and security problems.

en: Ebola outbreak: over 2,300 new confirmed cases in three weeks
Eastern conflict: M23/FRN fighting near Uvira and renewed ADF presence
Removal from FATF grey list as a positive institutional signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic (reported death toll above 5,000), a cholera outbreak in Mbandaka, active fighting in Masisi, and worsening hunger. Political tensions are also high, with a detained opposition figure denied bail and the president targeting Kabila allies.

en: Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 in DR Congo
Cholera outbreak in Mbandaka: 14 deaths, 129 cases
Violent FARDC-FRN combat in Masisi

summary.en: An Ebola outbreak with over 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases is spreading with no approved vaccine, alongside displacement, unaided humanitarian needs and killings in the east. Political tension over the Tshisekedi family case and arrests of a lawyer add to the strain, with only minor positives such as an airline lease and a promotional claim of eastern stability.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases
Thousands of displaced people without humanitarian assistance in North Kivu
Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict and Ebola

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths, ongoing armed conflict in the east, and a projected hunger crisis affecting over 30 million people. Modest positives, such as the release of about 50 ADF ex-hostages and cautious hope around US sanctions, do not offset this humanitarian catastrophe.

en: Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths
Projected hunger for over 30 million amid conflict and Ebola
Ongoing conflict with FRN/M23 and Rwanda tensions

summary.en: A large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, reportedly spreading), new ADF attacks forcing families to flee, and stalled peace talks with M23/FRN outweigh positives such as the exit from the FATF grey list. Overall the period reflects serious humanitarian and security strain rather than acute state collapse.

en: Ebola outbreak surpassing 10,000 cases and spreading in the east
ADF attack forcing hundreds of families to flee in Lubero
Fears of Doha process collapse over constitutional change

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious humanitarian and security problems: a cholera outbreak with about 1,800 deaths, an Ebola epidemic spreading to Beni, armed clashes killing civilians in Masisi, flooding, and severe malnutrition. Some positive items (WHO supplies, vaccine trials, community programmes) do not offset these crises.

en: Cholera outbreak reaching 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths
Ebola spreading, with Beni becoming the new epicentre in North Kivu
Civilians killed in FARDC-M23 clashes in Masisi

summary.en: Eastern DRC saw a deadly ADF attack that killed 10 civilians, ongoing fighting in Masisi and Uvira, and an active Ebola outbreak with an infected doctor evacuated. Some positives, such as FARDC retaking villages, new Ebola vaccine trials and a funded emergency health campaign, do not offset the serious security and health pressures.

en: ADF attack killed 10 civilians in eastern DR Congo
Ebola outbreak ongoing; infected doctor evacuated to London
Fighting in Masisi and Uvira; FARDC retook Mahanga and Kilongo

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak has passed 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases, and an ADF massacre in Beni killed at least 33 civilians, while FARDC-FRN fighting intensifies in North Kivu. Modest positives, such as new vaccine trials and a US-DRC partnership meeting, do not offset the scale of the humanitarian and security crisis.

en: Ebola deaths rise to 5,198 with 10,668 cases
ADF attack in Beni kills at least 33 civilians
Intensified FARDC-FRN fighting on Kashebere-Kibati axis

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: the Ebola outbreak is reported as the largest in the country's history, ADF attacks have forced suspected Ebola patients to flee, and 66 soldiers were sentenced to death. Ongoing states of siege and a nurses' strike add pressure, though WHO vaccine recommendations and a US-Congo minerals review offer some positive signals.

en: Ebola outbreak reported as largest in country's history
ADF attack causing Ebola patients to flee in Beni
66 military personnel sentenced to death in Goma

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a massacre in North Kivu, a new Ebola outbreak in the east, ADF attacks in Beni, flood damage in Gemena, and a military court sentencing 66 soldiers to death. Modest positives include the resumption of civil service pay and the reopening of the Kalamu bridge in Kinshasa.
summary.ja: この期間は深刻な問題が中心となっています。北キヴ州での虐殺、東部での新たなエボラ出血熱の発生、ベニでのADFによる攻撃、ゲメナでの洪水被害、そして軍事法廷による兵士66人への死刑判決です。明るい材料としては、公務員給与の支払い再開と、キンシャサのカラム橋の再開通が挙げられます。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 심각한 문제들이 주를 이룹니다. 북키부주에서의 학살, 동부 지역의 새로운 에볼라 발병, 베니에서의 ADF 공격, 젬베나의 홍수 피해, 그리고 군사법원이 병사 66명에게 사형을 선고한 사건이 있었습니다. 긍정적인 소식으로는 공무원 급여 지급 재개와 킨샤사 칼라무 다리의 재개통이 있습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में गंभीर समस्याएँ छाई रहीं: उत्तरी किवू में नरसंहार, पूर्वी क्षेत्र में ईबोला का नया प्रकोप, बेनी में ADF के हमले, गेमेना में बाढ़ से हुआ नुकसान, और एक सैन्य अदालत द्वारा 66 सैनिकों को मृत्युदंड की सजा। मामूली सकारात्मक बातों में नागरिक सेवा वेतन का फिर से शुरू होना और किंशासा में कलामू पुल का पुनः खुलना शामिल है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από σοβαρά προβλήματα: μια σφαγή στο Βόρειο Κίβου, ένα νέο κρούσμα Ebola στην ανατολή, επιθέσεις της ADF στο Μπένι, ζημιές από πλημμύρες στο Γκεμένα και μια στρατιωτική δικαιοσύνη που καταδίκασε σε θάνατο 66 στρατιώτες. Μέτριες θετικές εξελίξεις είναι η επανέναρξη της καταβολής μισθών δημοσίων υπαλλήλων και η επαναλειτουργία της γέφυρας Kalamu στην Κιν��άσα.
summary.tr: Dönem ağır sorunlarla damgalanmış durumda: Kuzey Kivu'da bir katliam, doğuda yeni bir Ebola salgını, Beni'de ADF saldırıları, Gemena'da sel hasarı ve bir askeri mahkemenin 66 askeri idama mahkûm etmesi. Mütevazı olumlu gelişmeler arasında kamu görevlilerinin maaşlarının yeniden ödenmeye başlaması ve Kinshasa'daki Kalamu köprüsünün yeniden açılması yer alıyor.
summary.es: El período está dominado por problemas graves: una masacre en Kivu Norte, un nuevo brote de ébola en el este, ataques de las ADF en Beni, daños por inundaciones en Gemena y un tribunal militar que condenó a muerte a 66 soldados. Entre los avances moderados figuran la reanudación del pago a los funcionarios públicos y la reapertura del puente Kalamu en Kinshasa.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par de graves problèmes : un massacre dans le Nord-Kivu, une nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola dans l'est, des attaques de l'ADF à Beni, des dégâts causés par les inondations à Gemena et un tribunal militaire qui a condamné 66 soldats à mort. Parmi les évolutions positives, on relève la reprise du paiement des salaires des fonctionnaires et la réouverture du pont de Kalamu à Kinshasa.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum ist von schwerwiegenden Problemen geprägt: ein Massaker in Nord-Kivu, ein neuer Ebola-Ausbruch im Osten, Angriffe der ADF in Beni, Überschwemmungsschäden in Gemena und ein Militärgericht, das 66 Soldaten zum Tode verurteilt. Zu den moderaten positiven Entwicklungen gehören die Wiederaufnahme der Gehaltszahlungen für den öffentlichen Dienst und die Wiedereröffnung der Kalamu-Brücke in Kinshasa.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por problemas graves: um massacre em Kivu do Norte, um novo surto de Ebola no leste, ataques das ADF em Beni, danos causados por inundações em Gemena e um tribunal militar que condenou 66 soldados à morte. Entre os aspectos positivos modestos, destacam-se a retomada do pagamento dos servidores públicos e a reabertura da ponte Kalamu em Kinshasa.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da gravi problemi: un massacro nel Nord Kivu, una nuova epidemia di Ebola nell'est, attacchi dell'ADF a Beni, danni causati dalle inondazioni a Gemena e una corte militare che ha condannato a morte 66 soldati. Tra gli aspetti positivi, di portata limitata, figurano la ripresa del pagamento degli stipendi dei dipendenti pubblici e la riapertura del ponte Kalamu a Kinshasa.
summary.ru: Период отмечен серьёзными проблемами: резня в Северном Киву, новая вспышка Эболы на востоке, нападения ADF в Бени, ущерб от наводнения в Гемене и военный суд, приговоривший 66 военнослужащих к смертной казни. Из скромных позитивных событий — возобновление выплаты зарплат госслужащим и открытие моста Каламу в Киншасе.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة مشكلات خطيرة: مجزرة في شمال كيفو، وتفشٍّ جديد لفيروس إيبولا في الشرق، وهجمات لتحالف القوى الديمقراطية (ADF) في بيني، وأضرار ناجمة عن الفيضانات في جيمينا، وحكم محكمة عسكرية بإعدام 66 جنديًا. ومن الإيجابيات المحدودة استئناف دفع رواتب موظفي الخدمة المدنية وإعادة فتح جسر كالامو في كينشاسا.
summary.fa: این دوره با مشکلات جدی همراه بوده است: کشتار در شمال کیوو، شیوع تازه ابولا در شرق، حملات ADF در بنی، خسارت سیل در جمینا و حکم اعدام 66 سرباز توسط دادگاه نظامی. از نکات مثبت محدود، از سرگیری پرداخت حقوق کارمندان دولت و بازگشایی پل کالامو در کینشاسا است.
summary.zh: 该时期以严重问题为主：北基伍发生大屠杀，东部出现新一轮埃博拉疫情，ADF在贝尼发动袭击，杰梅纳发生洪灾损失，军事法庭判处66名士兵死刑。适度的积极进展包括恢复公务员工资发放以及金沙萨卡卢穆桥重新开放。

summary.en: In Guinea over the last 24 hours there is a routine agenda: preparations for the Senate election, water and road infrastructure projects, a new state tobacco company, the start of the university term, and a corruption case. The Simandou iron ore project reaching a production rate of about 10 Mtpa is economically positive, while the fatal passenger accident at Séguéya is negative but local in scale. Since there is no clear crisis or major improvement, the score is near neutral, slightly positive.

en: Simandou iron ore production reaching a rate of about 10 Mtpa
Announcement of candidate bonds and campaign spending limits for the Senate elections
Announcement of water (600 million euros) and road infrastructure projects
Passenger accident at Séguéya resulting in 2 dead and 34 injured
Waiting time at the Port of Conakry falling to 15 days, with additional costs continuing

summary.en: The period mixes positive investment news (a $2bn UK Export Finance envelope and £330m in contracts) and a youth-participation initiative with routine judicial cases, a municipal wage-arrears strike threat and a magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake that the headlines show only as a government response plan. On balance this is an ordinary day with a slight positive lean.

en: UK Export Finance $2bn and £330m investment announcements
Magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake near Conakry, government prevention plan
Municipal wage arrears and threatened indefinite strike in Dixinn

summary.en: The period was mostly routine governance and economic news: judicial appointments, e-signature and public-finance reforms, and upbeat Simandou revenue and UK investment figures. The main negative item was a former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years, and GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Simandou revenue projections rising to $2.5 billion by 2040
UK investment ambition lifted above $3 billion
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: The period is mostly routine administration: a 4,500-post health recruitment, validation of a public finance reform plan, and Simandou diplomacy. The main negative item is the seven-year sentence of a former Constitutional Court president, alongside a security crackdown in Conakry, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years in prison
Conakry crackdown on crime and drug networks launched by prosecutor
Validation of 2026-2030 public finance reform strategy

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure approvals, a health recruitment drive, China partnership pledges and a strong run by the U18 team at the world school championship. Offsetting this are a jailing of a former Constitutional Court president and a union dispute, and GDELT tone (-0.33) is less negative than the world average.

en: Guinea U18 team advances at the world school championship
Labé–Tougué road and Kankan–Kissidougou works advance
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Guinea: the revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and rising inflation amid an oil crisis, but a state bond issue was heavily oversubscribed and a road loan was ratified. Security operations and union wage demands are ordinary news, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Oversubscribed state bond raising 4,579 billion GNF
Revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and higher inflation
Road loan for Labé-Tougué highway ratified

summary.en: The period was routine and mildly positive, dominated by youth football results (a U20 qualification for the CAN, a U18 World Cup final loss, and a U15 win) and a Horoya CAF qualification. Fuel prices were held at 12,000 GNF and new administrative units were created, with no sign of a political or security crisis.

en: U20 team qualifies for CAN 2027 final
Fuel price maintained at 12,000 GNF
Timbo and Wanindara administrative upgrades announced

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Guinea signed the Accra Convention on trade and SME credit, and a 2026 growth forecast of 8.6% was reported alongside Simandou progress. Offsetting this, a former Constitutional Court president was sentenced to seven years, and a journalist died, which keeps the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Signing of Accra Convention on trade and SME credit access
Reported 8.6% growth forecast for 2026 and Simandou push
Sentencing of former Constitutional Court president by CRIEF

summary.en: A largely routine day in Guinea: the state raised about 4,500 billion GNF on the local bank market and a $517 million bond, and new budget rules were validated. Negatives are minor, including contract teachers protesting exclusion from recruitment and complaints about the Kankan–Kissidougou road, and the GDELT tone (-0.10) is better than the world average.

en: State raised about 4,500 billion GNF on local banking market
$517 million state bond issuance mobilised
Public expenditure nomenclature and local accounting plan validated

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a successful 4,579 billion GNF bond issuance, Proparco financing for Soguipal, new ministerial and judicial appointments, and Simandou and China investment news. Negatives are limited to anger in Faranah over a student's death and job cuts at Bel Air Mining, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: State mobilised 4,579 billion GNF through its 2026 bond issue
Proparco's 5 million euro financing for Soguipal expansion
Anger in Faranah after a student's death, with hospital explanations

summary.en: Guinea's news over the period is mostly routine but leans positive, led by a government bond raise of 4,579 billion GNF (nearly double the target) and a $520 million local financing. Mining (Simandou), a UN visit and stadium homologation add to the stable picture, offset only by a military dismissals decree and a media-minister story.

en: Bond issue of 4,579 billion GNF, nearly double target
$520 million raised on local financial market
Simandou mining operations and Rio Tinto SimFer coverage

summary.en: Routine news dominated the period: a domestic bond issuance, a sports title, a hotel deal, and Simandou mining coverage, with GDELT tone (-0.10) well above the world average. Negatives were local (power shortages, administrative suspensions in Siguiri, student housing complaints), and no crisis or crackdown appears in the headlines.

en: Simandou mining coverage and a hotel development deal signed in Conakry
UFOA U20 football title and U18 school team's return from the world championship
Administrative suspensions in Siguiri and power shortages affecting communities

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a few positive signals: the parliament adopted the 2026 revised budget law, and a government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, well above target. Offsetting concerns include about 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported as blocked, and complaints from contract workers and villages lacking water.

en: Government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, exceeding initial target
Parliament adopted the revised 2026 budget law
About 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported blocked

summary.en: The period was mostly upbeat: the inauguration of the country's first gold refinery, a record bond issue, and new investment partnerships, alongside routine army anniversary events. Negatives were local and limited, including a water shortage protest in Kérouané and errors in a school digital system.

en: Inauguration of Nimba Gold Refinery, the country's first gold refinery
Record bond issue in Guinean francs and new Samsung investment partnership
Local water shortage protest and school digital system errors

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: the inauguration of a first gold refinery and urban-rehabilitation projects are positive, while the central bank's warnings on liquidity and cash shortages and the army deployment against illegal gold mining in Siguiri weigh against them. GDELT tone is above the world average, so the overall picture is slightly positive.

en: First gold refinery inaugurated in Conakry, reported by multiple outlets
Central bank warns of liquidity crisis and banknote shortage
State deploys army against anarchic gold mining in Siguiri

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news with serious concerns: mass dismissals of local officials over illegal gold mining in Siguiri, a detained former official's unclear fate, and an alleged abduction ending in death. Positive items, including a new gold refinery and a regional diplomatic appointment, and a tone more negative than the world average keep the score just below neutral.

en: Mass dismissals of 479 local officials and 22 administrators over illegal gold mining
Alleged abduction and death of Boubacar Barry; detained ex-OGP head's health and fate
Proposed anti-terrorism bill raising concerns about civil liberties

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine anti-corruption prosecutions and administrative dismissals over illegal gold mining, alongside a state gold refinery inauguration and a regional vote scheduled for 29 November. Negatives include slowing growth, rising inflation, mass departures of foreign miners after the mining ban, and an unpaid $29bn arbitration claim.

en: Mass departure of foreign miners after illegal gold mining ban
Growth slowing and inflation rising, per government explanations
Dismissals of 22 officials and 479 local leaders in Siguiri

summary.en: The period is dominated by the army's closure of Siguiri gold mines, expulsions of Burkinabe miners, a diplomatic row with Burkina Faso and a reported humanitarian crisis of displaced people on the Mali border. Some routine governance and economic news (a gold refinery inauguration, a workplace-injury compensation decree) partly offsets this, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Army closes Siguiri gold mines; expulsions of foreign miners
Diplomatic tension with Burkina Faso over expulsions and treatment
Humanitarian displacement at Mali-Guinea border reported

summary.en: The period mixes positive news (release of opposition leader Aliou Bah, a Chinese alumina EPC contract, regional energy integration) with serious strain from the crackdown on illegal gold mining. Thousands of foreigners were reportedly arrested and expelled, mines were closed, and layoffs and garbage backlogs followed, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Thousands of foreigners arrested and expelled over illegal gold mining
Release of opposition leader Aliou Bah
Siguiri mine closures hitting poultry sector and households

summary.en: Guinea's news flow is dominated by positive economic and institutional developments: the Simandou mining summit, investor outreach, a rectified budget, new international retail投资 in Conakry, and the release of opposition figure Aliou Bah. This is offset by a large anti-illegal-gold-mining operation with mass arrests and expulsions, which foreign media describe as a humanitarian concern.

en: Simandou Mining Summit and investor calls dominate coverage
Release of opposition figure Aliou Bah after nearly two years
Mass expulsions and 1,263 arrests in anti-illegal-gold-mining operations

summary.en: Guinea's period was dominated by a large anti-illegal-gold-mining crackdown, with over 1,200 arrests and reports of tens of thousands of miners expelled into Mali, creating a humanitarian emergency at the border. Offsetting this, budget and investment news was routine to mildly positive, including a deficit reported at 2.01% of GDP and a $900m AngloGold investment.
summary.ja: ギニアでは、違法な金採掘に対する大規模な取り締まりが期間の中心的な話題となり、1,200人以上が逮捕されたほか、数万人の採掘者がマリへ追放されたと報じられ、国境で人道危機が生じた。一方、予算と投資に関するニュースは日常的からやや前向きなもので、GDP比2.01%の赤字の報告や、AngloGoldによる9億ドルの投資が含まれていた。
summary.ko: 기니의 이 기간은 불법 금 채굴에 대한 대규모 단속이 지배적이었으며, 1,200명 이상이 체포되고 수만 명의 광부가 말리로 추방되어 국경에서 인도주의적 비상사태가 발생했다는 보도가 있었다. 이와 상쇄되어 예산 및 투자 소식은 일상적이거나 약간 긍정적이었으며, GDP의 2.01%로 보고된 적자와 AngloGold의 9억 달러 투자가 포함되었다.
summary.hi: गिनी की इस अवधि में अवैध सोने के खनन के खिलाफ एक बड़ी कार्रवाई हावी रही, जिसमें 1,200 से अधिक गिरफ्तारियाँ हुईं और दसियों हज़ार खननकर्ताओं को माली में निष्कासित किए जाने की रिपोर्टें आईं, जिससे सीमा पर मानवीय आपातकाल उत्पन्न हो गया। इसके विपरीत, बजट और निवेश से जुड़ी खबरें सामान्य से लेकर हल्की सकारात्मक रहीं, जिनमें GDP के 2.01% पर दर्ज घाटा और AngloGold का $900m का निवेश शामिल है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος της Γουινέας κυριαρχήθηκε από μια μεγάλη καταστολή της παράνομης εξόρυξης χρυσού, με πάνω από 1.200 συλλήψεις και αναφορές ότι δεκάδες χιλιάδες εξορύκτες εκδιώχθηκαν στο Μάλι, γεγονός που δημιούργησε ανθρωπιστική έκτακτη ανάγκη στα σύνορα. Αντισταθμιστικά, τα νέα για τον προϋπολογισμό και τις επενδύσεις ήταν συνήθη έως ελαφρώς θετικά, συμπεριλαμβανομένου ενός ελλείμματος που αναφέρθηκε στο 2,01% του ΑΕΠ και μιας επένδυσης 900 εκατ. δολαρίων της AngloGold.
summary.it: Il periodo della Guinea è stato dominato da un vasto giro di vite contro l'estrazione illegale dell'oro, con oltre 1.200 arresti e segnalazioni di decine di migliaia di minatori espulsi in Mali, che ha creato un'emergenza umanitaria al confine. Controbilanciando ciò, le notizie su bilancio e investimenti sono state di routine o leggermente positive, tra cui un deficit riportato al 2,01% del PIL e un investimento di AngloGold da 900 milioni di dollari.
summary.ru: В период, охваченный новостями, в Гвинее доминировала масштабная кампания против незаконной добычи золота: более 1200 арестов и сообщения о высылке в Мали десятков тысяч старателей, что создало гуманитарную чрезвычайную ситуацию на границе. В противовес этому новости о бюджете и инвестициях были рутинными или умеренно позитивными, включая сообщённый дефицит на уровне 2,01% ВВП и инвестицию AngloGold в размере 900 млн долларов.
summary.ar: هيمنت على فترة غينيا حملة واسعة ضد التنقيب غير المشروع عن الذهب، أسفرت عن أكثر من 1200 اعتقال وتقارير عن طرد عشرات الآلاف من عمال المناجم إلى مالي، مما خلق حالة طوارئ إنسانية على الحدود. وفي المقابل، كانت أخبار الميزانية والاستثمار روتينية إلى إيجابية بشكل طفيف، including عجز مُعلن بنسبة 2.01% من الناتج المحلي الإجمالي واستثمار لشركة أنغلوغولد بقيمة 900 مليون دولار.
summary.fa: دوره گینه عمدتاً تحت تأثیر یک سرکوب گسترده علیه استخراج غیرقانونی طلا بود که با بیش از ۱۲۰۰ بازداشت و گزارش‌هایی از اخراج ده‌ها هزار معدنچی به مالی همراه شد و بحران انسانی در مرز ایجاد کرد. در مقابل، اخبار بودجه و سرمایه‌گذاری عادی تا اندکی مثبت بود، از جمله کسری گزارش‌شده به میزان ۲٫۰۱ درصد تولید ناخالص داخلی و سرمایه‌گذاری ۹۰۰ میلیون دلاری شرکت AngloGold.
summary.zh: 几内亚这一时期的新闻主要围绕大规模打击非法采金行动展开，超过1200人被捕，据报道数以万计的矿工被驱逐至马里，在边境造成人道主义紧急情况。与此相对，预算和投资新闻属于常规或略为积极的内容，包括报告的赤字占GDP的2.01%以及AngloGold的9亿美元投资。
summary.tr: Gine'nin bu dönemi, yasa dışı altın madenciliğine karşı geniş kapsamlı bir operasyonla damgasını vurdu; 1.200'den fazla tutuklama yapıldı ve on binlerce madencinin Mali'ye sınır dışı edildiği bildirildi, bu da sınırda insani bir acil duruma yol açtı. Bunu dengeleyen bütçe ve yatırım haberleri ise rutin ila hafif olumluydu; GSYİH'nin %2,01'i olarak bildirilen bir açık ve 900 milyon dolarlık bir AngloGold yatırımı dahil.
summary.es: El período de Guinea estuvo dominado por una gran operación contra la minería ilegal de oro, con más de 1.200 detenciones y reportes de decenas de miles de mineros expulsados a Malí, lo que generó una emergencia humanitaria en la frontera. Como contrapeso, las noticias presupuestarias y de inversión fueron rutinarias o levemente positivas, incluido un déficit reportado en el 2,01 % del PIB y una inversión de 900 millones de dólares de AngloGold.
summary.fr: La période en Guinée a été dominée par une vaste opération de répression contre l'orpaillage illégal, avec plus de 1 200 arrestations et des signalements faisant état de dizaines de milliers de mineurs expulsés vers le Mali, ce qui a créé une urgence humanitaire à la frontière. En contrepoint, les informations budgétaires et d'investissement étaient de routine à légèrement positives, notamment un déficit annoncé à 2,01 % du PIB et un investissement de 900 millions de dollars d'AngloGold.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung über Guinea wurde von einer groß angelegten Razzia gegen illegalen Goldabbau bestimmt, bei der über 1.200 Festnahmen erfolgten und Berichte von Zehntausenden nach Mali ausgewiesenen Minenarbeitern vorlagen, was an der Grenze eine humanitäre Notlage schuf. Ausgleichend waren die Nachrichten zu Haushalt und Investitionen routinemäßig bis leicht positiv, darunter ein mit 2,01 % des BIP gemeldetes Defizit und eine Investition von AngloGold in Höhe von 900 Mio. US-Dollar.

Em contrapartida, as notícias sobre orçamento e investimento foram rotineiras ou levemente positivas, incluindo um déficit reportado em 2,01% do PIB e um investimento de US$ 900 milhões da AngloGold.

summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: بازگشایی یک تئاتر ملی، ابتکارهای تازه هوش مصنوعی در حوزه سلامت، و گزارش‌هایی مبنی بر اینکه میانگین دستمزد خالص در بلغارستان بالاتر از رومانی است. جنبه‌های منفی شامل کاهش ۱۲ درصدی آگهی‌های شغلی، اختلاف بین مقامات ارشد دولتی بر سر مستمری‌ها، قطعی‌های پراکنده برق، و حملات پهپادی به کشتی‌ها در دریای سیاه نزدیک است؛ لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期总体上较为平常：一座国家剧院重新开放，出现了新的医疗人工智能举措，并有报道称保加利亚的平均税后工资高于罗马尼亚。负面因素包括招聘广告下降12%、高级政府官员之间的养老金争议、零星停电，以及附近黑海的船只遭到无人机袭击；GDELT的语气比全球平均水平更为负面。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin gelişmelerden oluşuyor: yeniden açılan bir ulusal tiyatro, yeni yapay zekâ destekli sağlık girişimleri ve Bulgaristan'ın ortalama net ücretinin Romanya'nın üzerinde olduğuna dair haberler. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında iş ilanlarında %12'lik düşüş, yetkililer arasında emeklilik maaşlarına ilişkin bir anlaşmazlık, bölgesel elektrik kesintileri ve yakındaki Karadeniz'de gemilere yönelik İHA saldırıları yer alıyor; GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz.
summary.es: El periodo transcurre en gran medida con normalidad: un teatro nacional reabierto, nuevas iniciativas de salud basadas en inteligencia artificial e informes según los cuales el salario neto medio de Bulgaria supera al de Rumanía. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran una caída del 12 % en los anuncios de empleo, una disputa sobre las pensiones entre altos funcionarios, cortes de electricidad dispersos y ataques con drones contra buques en el cercano mar Negro; el tono de GDELT es más negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : un théâtre national rouvert, de nouvelles initiatives de santé fondées sur l'IA et des rapports selon lesquels le salaire net moyen en Bulgarie dépasse celui de la Roumanie. Les aspects négatifs comprennent une baisse de 12 % des offres d'emploi, un différend sur les retraites entre hauts responsables, des coupures de courant dispersées et des attaques de drones contre des navires en mer Noire voisine ; le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief überwiegend routinemäßig: ein wiedereröffnetes Nationaltheater, neue KI-gestützte Gesundheitsinitiativen sowie Berichte, wonach das durchschnittliche Nettoeinkommen in Bulgarien über dem in Rumänien liegt. Zu den negativen Entwicklungen zählen ein Rückgang der Stellenanzeigen um 12 %, ein Streit über die Renten zwischen hochrangigen Amtsträgern, vereinzelte Stromausfälle sowie Drohnenangriffe auf Schiffe im nahen Schwarzen Meer; der GDELT-Tonwert ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período foi, em grande parte, de rotina: um teatro nacional reaberto, novas iniciativas de saúde com inteligência artificial e relatos de que o salário líquido médio da Bulgária está acima do da Roménia. Entre os aspetos negativos estão uma queda de 12% nos anúncios de emprego, uma disputa sobre pensões entre altos funcionários, cortes de energia pontuais e ataques com drones a navios no vizinho Mar Negro; o tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial.

summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: مسيرات نقابية ومواطنية احتجاجًا على ديون الدولة المستحقة لصندوق الرعاية الصحية CCSS، واكتظاظ في مستشفى في ألاخويلا، وتراجع في وظائف القطاع الزراعي، مقابل أخبار عن الترويج للسياحة وكفاءات التكنولوجيا والابتكار الطلابي. تتفوق الأخبار السلبية قليلاً على الإيجابية، بينما نبرة GDELT إيجابية بشكل طفيف، لذا يقع المؤشر أدنى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: راهپیمایی‌های اتحادیه‌ها و شهروندان درباره بدهی دولت به صندوق بهداشتی CCSS، شلوغی بیش از حد بیمارستانی در الاخوئلا، و کاهش مشاغل بخش کشاورزی، در برابر اخبار مربوط به تبلیغ گردشگری، استعدادهای فناوری و نوآوری دانشجویی. موارد منفی اندکی بیشتر از موارد مثبت‌اند، در حالی که لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است، پس امتیاز کمی پایین‌تر از یک روز معمولی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 该时段大多属于常规情况：工会和市民游行要求政府偿还欠CCSS医疗基金的债务，阿拉胡埃拉一家医院人满为患，农业就业岗位减少，同时也有旅游推广、科技人才和学生创新方面的报道。负面消息略多于正面消息，而GDELT语气略为正面，因此得分略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde olağan seyirde geçti: sendika ve vatandaş yürüyüşleri devletin CCSS sağlık fonuna olan borçlarına karşı düzenlendi, Alajuela'daki bir hastanede aşırı kalabalık yaşandı ve tarım sektöründe istihdam düştü. Bunlara turizm tanıtımı, teknoloji yetenekleri ve öğrenci inovasyonu haberleri karşı duruyor. Olumsuz haberler olumlulardan biraz fazla, GDELT tonu ise hafifçe olumlu; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz altında kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo fue en su mayoría rutinario: marchas de sindicatos y ciudadanos por la deuda estatal con el fondo de salud de la CCSS, hacinamiento en un hospital de Alajuela y una caída del empleo agrícola, frente a noticias sobre promoción turística, talento tecnológico e innovación estudiantil. Los elementos negativos superan ligeramente a los positivos, mientras que el tono de GDELT es levemente positivo, por lo que la puntuación queda justo por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période a été globalement routinière : des marches syndicales et citoyennes contre la dette de l'État envers le fonds de santé de la CCSS, la surpopulation d'un hôpital d'Alajuela et une baisse des emplois agricoles, face à des nouvelles sur la promotion touristique, les talents technologiques et l'innovation étudiante. Les éléments négatifs l'emportent légèrement sur les positifs, tandis que le ton de GDELT est légèrement positif ; le score se situe donc juste en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief größtenteils routinemäßig: Demonstrationen von Gewerkschaften und Bürgern wegen der Staatsschulden gegenüber dem Gesundheitsfonds CCSS, Überfüllung eines Krankenhauses in Alajuela und ein Rückgang der Arbeitsplätze in der Landwirtschaft stehen Berichten über Tourismusförderung, Technologietalente und studentische Innovationen gegenüber. Negative Meldungen überwiegen leicht gegenüber positiven, während der GDELT-Ton leicht positiv ist; der Wert liegt daher knapp unter einem gewöhnlichen Tag.
summary.pt: O período foi em grande parte rotineiro: marchas de sindicatos e cidadãos contra a dívida do Estado com o fundo de saúde da CCSS, superlotação de um hospital em Alajuela e queda nos empregos agrícolas, em contraste com notícias sobre promoção turística, talentos em tecnologia e inovação estudantil. Os itens negativos superam ligeiramente os positivos, enquanto o tom do GDELT é levemente positivo, por isso a pontuação fica logo abaixo de um dia comum.
summary.ja: 今期はおおむね平常どおりである。国家の債務をCCSS医療基金に支払うよう求める労働組合と市民のデモ、アラフエラの病院の混雑、農業部門の雇用減少が報じられた一方、観光振興、技術人材、学生のイノベーションに関する話題もあった。否定的な項目が肯定的な項目をわずかに上回り、GDELTのトーンはやや肯定的であるため、スコアは通常の日をわずかに下回る水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평범하다. 국가 부채를 CCSS 건강 기금에 상환하라는 노동조합과 시민들의 행진, 알라후엘라 병원의 과밀 현상, 농업 일자리 감소가 있었고, 관광 진흥, 기술 인재, 학생 혁신 관련 소식도 있었다. 부정적 항목이 긍정적 항목을 약간 앞서지만 GDELT 어조는 완만하게 긍정적이어서, 점수는 평범한 날보다 조금 낮은 수준이다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य है: CCSS स्वास्थ्य कोष को देय राज्य ऋण के भुगतान की मांग को लेकर श्रमिक संघों और नागरिकों के मार्च, अलाजुएला के एक अस्पताल में भीड़भाड़, और कृषि नौकरियों में गिरावट, जबकि पर्यटन प्रचार, तकनीकी प्रतिभा और छात्र नवाचार की खबरें भी रहीं। नकारात्मक खबरें सकारात्मक खबरों से थोड़ी अधिक हैं, जबकि GDELT स्वर हल्का सकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη: διαδηλώσεις συνδικάτων και πολιτών για τα κρατικά χρέη προς το ταμείο υγείας CCSS, υπερπληρότητα σε νοσοκομείο της Αλαχουέλα και μείωση των θέσεων εργασίας στον αγροτικό τομέα, ενώ υπάρχουν και ειδήσεις για την προώθηση του τουρισμού, το ταλέντο στην τεχνολογία και την καινοτομία των φοιτητών. Τα αρνητικά θέματα υπερτερούν ελαφρώς των θετικών, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ήπια θετικός, οπότε η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται λίγο κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.en: Forest fires in Peru have caused 12 deaths and affected more than 800 people. El Niño risk, rains in Piura and a rising teen homicide rate are also in the news. On the other hand, there are routine developments such as an increase in banana exports, a tuberculosis vaccine project and local elections, but the positive news does not offset the negative. A day somewhat below average: serious, but not at the level of a widespread crisis.

en: Forest fires leave 12 dead and more than 800 affected
El Niño warnings and heavy rains in Piura
Decade-high teen homicides in Lima
25 Peruvians dead and 187 missing in the Russian army
Banana exports up 24.6% and a tuberculosis vaccine study

summary.en: Peru's period is dominated by El Niño-related flooding and wind alerts in the north and coast, with forecasts warning that worse rains are still to come, plus an electoral recount dispute in Piura. Positive items, including the Peru-Ecuador cooperation declaration and the Andean Community presidency, do not offset the disaster risk, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: El Niño floods in Piura and Tumbes, with school and market closures
Senamhi warns the heaviest rains are still to come
JNE orders vote recount in Piura over damaged records

summary.en: Peru faces an El Niño threat, with flooding in Piura, red rain alerts for several regions, and warnings of a 'Mega Niño', alongside a more negative-than-average news tone. Some positives appear, including a Citi view that Peru may respond best to El Niño in Latin America and a healthcare investment milestone, but the flood and climate risks dominate, pulling the score below an ordinary day.

en: Piura flooding and street collapse, with unspent flood-fund criticism
Senamhi red and orange rain alerts and 'Mega Niño' forecasts
Citi sees Peru's El Niño economic response as strongest in Latin America

summary.en: Peru faces a strong El Niño with flooding in Piura and Tumbes, port closures from heavy swells, and 12 fire deaths, alongside ongoing extortion and armed attacks. Government responses such as a supplementary budget credit for El Niño and emergency evacuation guidance partly offset the strain, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Strong El Niño causing flooding in Piura and northern coast
Fires linked to El Niño leave 12 dead
75 ports closed due to anomalous swells

summary.en: Peru's period is mostly routine: preparations for the Pope's visit, a solar investment, and relief measures for El Niño and wildfire victims. Negatives include El Niño damage, forest fires, illegal mining, a police shootout and a decree-powers grant, but no crisis of mass violence or institutional breakdown appears.

en: Government announces S/2,500M in bonuses for El Niño-affected families
El Niño rains and wildfires damaging crops and communities
Fujimori gets 90 days of decree powers to legislate

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and institutional news, including the Lote 192 oil deal, the return of Air Canada and papal visit preparations, with serious stress from extortion and kidnapping, drought, forest fires and El Niño underspending. Tone matches the world average, so the net picture is an ordinary-to-slightly-strained day.

en: Lote 192 deal: Petroloreto takes 75% and operates for 27 years
Surge in kidnapping and extortion reported by foreign media
Protests in Lima over insecurity and forest fires

summary.en: Peru's period looks broadly routine: regional election results and runoffs, preparations for the Pope's visit, and a private investment deal for Petroperú's Lot 192. Weighing against this are El Niño rains, a forest fire in Apurímac, falling cacao exports and a reported tourism decline.

en: Petroperú ceding Lot 192 to private firm with $230M investment
El Niño rains and cacao export decline
Forest fire in Apurímac needing urgent aerial aid

summary.en: The period mixes a major positive development, the confirmed Papal visit that is broadly welcomed, with weather-related disruption, including a Senamhi red alert for extreme rain across 11 departments and flooding in Tumbes. Ongoing security measures, the Petroperú restructuring and municipal election disputes add routine strain, and the news tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Confirmed Papal visit to Peru welcomed across domestic media

summary.en: Peru faces active flood emergencies: red-alert rains in Tumbes and Piura, a river overflow in Cusco that trapped people, and medicine shortages in the health system. Positive signals include flood-prevention expropriations, the upcoming papal visit, and steady corporate and mining news, so the overall picture is a serious but localized disaster period.

summary.en: The period is dominated by El Niño rain and heat records, flood alerts and local complaints about inadequate prevention, which weigh on the score. Partly offsetting this are preparations for the papal visit, record remittances and infrastructure investment interest, while a setback for justice in the forced sterilizations case adds to the negatives.

en: Record rainfall and flood alerts linked to El Niño across northern and coastal regions

summary.en: Peru's period mixes routine news with forward-looking positives, including preparations for Pope Leo XIV's visit and an MEF forecast of export growth. Weather risks from El Niño, heavy rain in Piura, a heat wave, a large power outage and a dengue warning, plus a more negative-than-average news tone, offset those gains, so the day reads as roughly ordinary.

en: Papal visit preparations and planned events across the country
El Niño rain warnings for Piura and Tumbes
MEF forecast that Peru's exports will surpass Chile's

summary.en: Peru's period mixes ordinary politics with a regional flood isolating communities in Piura and Huancabamba and growing El Niño risk to growth. Positive items include an upgraded China trade deal from November 1, a pension expansion vote, and the routine proclamation of regional election results, so the balance is near a typical day.

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: preparations for the papal visit, tourism records, and an upgraded China-Peru free trade protocol entering into force. These are offset by a significant El Niño warning, coastal swells, power cuts, and ongoing violence, but no acute crisis is reported.

en: China-Peru FTA upgrade protocol entered into force

summary.en: Peru faces a serious period driven by intense rains and a feared Super El Niño, with red alerts, blackouts across five northern regions, and a Senate grant of emergency powers. Inflation topping 5% and an estimated 3,200 heat-related deaths add strain, partly offset by a large mining investment and a China trade upgrade.

en: Super El Niño threat and red alert for intense rains

summary.en: Peru faces a serious El Niño-driven emergency: a state of emergency in 1,380 districts, floods in Piura and Tumbes, and warnings of water and power shortages. Modest positives include Petroperú's profit and Alicorp's acquisition, but the disaster response dominates and the tone is clearly negative.

summary.en: Peru's news flow is mixed: El Niño flooding, extreme heat and anomalous sea conditions are driving emergencies, and October was the most violent month of the current government, with homicides at 182. summary.en: Peru's news mix is heavily negative, driven by El Niño flooding in Tumbes and dengue deaths, plus high homicide and insecurity figures during the new government's first 100 days. summary.en: The period mixes routine news with some strengths: record-pace exports to China, a papal visit, and a clear JNE ruling on municipal re-election disputes. summary.en: The period looks mostly routine, with preparations for Pope Leo XIV's visit and sports and trade news. Negative signals include El Niño impacts on fishing and an economic outlook, flooding in Huaraz, and a crime case, but no acute crisis appears in the headlines.
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね平常通りに見え、教皇レオ14世の訪問準備や、スポーツと貿易のニュースが中心となっている。エルニーニョ現象による漁業への影響や経済見通し、ワラスでの洪水、そして犯罪事件といった否定的な兆候も見られるが、見出しに急迫した危機は現れていない。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평상시처럼 보이며, 교황 레오 14세 방문 준비와 스포츠 및 무역 소식이 주를 이룬다. 엘니뇨가 어업에 미치는 영향과 경제 전망, 우아라스의 홍수, 범죄 사건 등 부정적 신호도 있지만 헤드라인에서 급박한 위기는 드러나지 않는다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर सामान्य गतिविधियाँ दिखती हैं, जिनमें पोप लियो XIV की यात्रा की तैयारियाँ तथा खेल और व्यापार से जुड़ी खबरें शामिल हैं। मत्स्य उद्योग पर अल नीनो का प्रभाव और आर्थिक दृष्टिकोण, हुआराज़ में बाढ़ तथा एक अपराध मामला जैसे नकारात्मक संकेत भी हैं, लेकिन सुर्खियों में कोई तीव्र संकट नहीं दिखता।
summary.el: Η περίοδος φαίνεται κυρίως συνηθισμένη, με προετοιμασίες για την επίσκεψη του Πάπα Λέοντα XIV και ειδήσεις για τον αθλητισμό και το εμπόριο. Αρνητικά σημάδια αποτελούν οι επιπτώσεις του Ελ Νίνιο στην αλιεία και οι οικονομικές προοπτικές, οι πλημμύρες στο Ουαράθ και μια υπόθεση εγκληματικότητας, ωστόσο στους τίτλους δεν εμφανίζεται καμία οξεία κρίση.
summary.it: Il periodo appare per lo più di routine, con i preparativi per la visita di Papa Leone XIV e notizie sportive e commerciali. I segnali negativi includono gli effetti di El Niño sulla pesca e sulle prospettive economiche, un'alluvione a Huaraz e un caso di criminalità, ma nei titoli non emerge alcuna crisi acuta.
summary.ru: Период выглядит в основном рутинным: идут приготовления к визиту Папы Льва XIV, есть спортивные и торговые новости. Негативные сигналы включают влияние Эль-Ниньо на рыболовство и экономические прогнозы, наводнение в Уарасе и уголовное дело, однако в заголовках не видно острого кризиса.
summary.ar: يبدو أن الفترة روتينية في معظمها، مع استعدادات لزيارة البابا لاوون الرابع عشر وأخبار رياضية وتجارية. وتشمل المؤشرات السلبية آثار ظاهرة النينيو على الصيد والتوقعات الاقتصادية، وفيضانات في واراز، وقضية جنائية، لكن العناوين لا تُظهر أزمة حادة.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی به نظر می‌رسد، با آماده‌سازی برای سفر پاپ لئو چهاردهم و اخبار ورزشی و تجاری. نشانه‌های منفی شامل تأثیرات ال‌نینیو بر ماهیگیری و چشم‌انداز اقتصادی، سیل در واراز و یک پرونده جنایی است، اما در عناوین خبری بحران حاد دیده نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 这一时期总体看似平常，主要是为教宗良十四世访问做准备，以及体育和贸易新闻。负面信号包括厄尔尼诺对渔业的影响和经济前景、瓦拉斯的洪水以及一起刑事案件，但头条新闻中未见明显的急性危机。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin görünüyor; Papa XIV. Leo'nun ziyaretine yönelik hazırlıklar ile spor ve ticaret haberleri öne çıkıyor. Olumsuz sinyaller arasında El Niño'nun balıkçılık ve ekonomik görünüm üzerindeki etkileri, Huaraz'daki sel ve bir suç davası yer alıyor; ancak manşetlerde akut bir kriz görünmüyor.
summary.es: El periodo parece en gran medida rutinario, con preparativos para la visita del papa León XIV y noticias deportivas y comerciales. Entre las señales negativas figuran los impactos de El Niño en la pesca y las perspectivas económicas, las inundaciones en Huaraz y un caso penal, pero en los titulares no aparece ninguna crisis aguda.
summary.fr: La période semble globalement routinière, avec les préparatifs de la visite du pape Léon XIV ainsi que des nouvelles sportives et commerciales. Les signaux négatifs incluent les effets d'El Niño sur la pêche et les perspectives économiques, les inondations à Huaraz et une affaire criminelle, mais aucune crise aiguë n'apparaît dans les titres.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wirkt überwiegend routinemäßig, mit Vorbereitungen für den Besuch von Papst Leo XIV. sowie Sport- und Wirtschaftsnachrichten. Negative Signale betreffen die Auswirkungen von El Niño auf die Fischerei und die Wirtschaftsaussichten, Überschwemmungen in Huaraz und einen Kriminalfall; in den Schlagzeilen zeichnet sich jedoch keine akute Krise ab.
summary.pt: O período parece majoritariamente rotineiro, com preparativos para a visita do Papa Leão XIV e notícias de esportes e comércio. Os sinais negativos incluem os impactos do El Niño na pesca e nas perspectivas econômicas, enchentes em Huaraz e um caso criminal, mas não há uma crise aguda nas manchetes.

summary.tr: Çoğunlukla rutin geçen bir gün; hava kirliliği haberleri öne çıkıyor. Saraybosna dünyanın en kirli şehirleri arasında defalarca gösterildi; ayrıca bir demiryolu depo yangını ve seçim fonlarıyla ilgili bir anlaşmazlık da haberlerde yer aldı. Hafif olumlu gelişmeler arasında Saraybosna havalimanının ikimilyonuncu yolcusu ve Ekim ayı borsa işlem hacmi yer alıyor; GDELT tonu ise dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz.
summary.es: Un día mayormente rutinario, dominado por la cobertura de la contaminación del aire, con Sarajevo citada repetidamente entre las ciudades más contaminadas del mundo, además de un incendio en un depósito ferroviario y una disputa por fondos electorales. Entre los aspectos ligeramente positivos figuran el pasajero dos millones del aeropuerto de Sarajevo y el volumen de operaciones bursátiles de octubre; el tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial.
summary.fr: Une journée globalement ordinaire, dominée par la couverture de la pollution atmosphérique, Sarajevo étant à plusieurs reprises classée parmi les villes les plus polluées au monde, avec également un incendie dans un dépôt ferroviaire et un différend sur des fonds électoraux. Parmi les éléments légèrement positifs figurent le deux millionième passager de l'aéroport de Sarajevo et le volume des transactions boursières d'octobre ; le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Ein überwiegend routinemäßiger Tag, der von der Berichterstattung über Luftverschmutzung geprägt ist; Sarajevo wird wiederholt unter den meistverschmutzten Städten der Welt genannt. Hinzu kommen ein Brand in einem Bahndepot und ein Streit über nicht nachgewiesene Wahlkampfgelder. Leicht positive Meldungen betreffen den zwei millionsten Passagier des Flughafens Sarajevo und den Oktober-Umsatz an der Börse; der GDELT-Tonwert ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: Um dia em grande parte rotineiro, dominado pela cobertura da poluição do ar, com Sarajevo repetidamente classificada entre as cidades mais poluídas do mundo, além de um incêndio em um depósito ferroviário e uma disputa sobre fundos eleitorais. Entre os aspectos levemente positivos estão o segundo milionésimo passageiro do aeroporto de Sarajevo e o volume de negociações da bolsa em outubro; o tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial.
summary.ja: ほぼ平常どおりの一日で、大気汚染に関する報道が中心でした。サラエボは世界で最も汚染された都市の一つとして繰り返し挙げられ、ほかにはラヨヴァツの鉄道車両基地での火災や、ビイェリナにおける使途不明の選挙資金をめぐる対立がありました。サラエボ空港の200万人目の乗客や10月の株式取引高といった小さな明るい材料もありますが、GDELTのトーンは世界平均より否定的です。

summary.hi: लगभग सामान्य दिन रहा, जिसमें वायु प्रदूषण की कवरेज हावी रही। सराजेवो को बार-बार दुनिया के सबसे प्रदूषित शहरों में गिना गया, साथ ही रायलोवैक में एक रेलवे डिपो में आग लगी और बिजेलजीना में अज्ञात चुनाव निधि को लेकर विवाद हुआ। सराजेवो हवाई अड्डे का दो-मिलियनवाँ यात्री और अक्टूबर में शेयर बाज़ार का कारोबार जैसे हल्के सकारात्मक संकेत भी रहे, और GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है।

Ήπιες θετικές ειδήσεις αποτέλεσαν ο δύο-εκατομμυριοστός επιβάτης του αεροδρομίου του Σαράγεβο και ο κύκλος εργασιών του χρηματιστηρίου τον Οκτώβριο, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: Una giornata per lo più ordinaria, dominata dalla copertura sull'inquinamento atmosferico, con Sarajevo ripetutamente classificata tra le città più inquinate del mondo, oltre a un incendio in un deposito ferroviario e a una controversia sui fondi elettorali. Qualche nota positiva include il due milionesimo passeggero dell'aeroporto di Sarajevo e il fatturato della Borsa di ottobre, mentre il tono GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale.

Также произошёл пожар на железнодорожном депо и возник спор о выборных средствах. Небольшими позитивными моментами стали два миллионных пассажира аэропорта Сараево и оборот фондовой биржи за октябрь; тон GDELT при этом более негативен, чем среднемировой.

summary.es: El período está dominado por avances positivos habituales: la conferencia tecnológica MWC26 Doha, alianzas en inteligencia artificial y telecomunicaciones, un evento de MotoGP con asistencia récord y el papel continuado de Catar como mediador entre Estados Unidos e Irán. summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da sviluppi positivi di routine: la conferenza tecnologica MWC26 di Doha, partnership nel settore dell'intelligenza artificiale e delle telecomunicazioni, un evento MotoGP con affluenza record e il ruolo continuo del Qatar come mediatore tra Stati Uniti e Iran. summary.ru: В этот период преобладают обычные позитивные события: технологическая конференция MWC26 в Дохе, партнёрства в сфере ИИ и телекоммуникаций, мероприятие MotoGP с рекордной посещаемостью и продолжающаяся роль Катара как посредника между США и Ираном. summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة تطورات إيجابية روتينية: مؤتمر MWC26 للتقنية في الدوحة، وشراكات في الذكاء الاصطناعي والاتصالات، وفعالية MotoGP بحضور قياسي، واستمرار دور قطر كوسيط بين الولايات المتحدة وإيران. ونبرة GDELT (-0.14) أقل سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، دون مؤشرات على أزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً با تحولات مثبت معمولی مشخص می‌شود: کنفرانس فناوری MWC26 در دوحه، همکاری‌ها در حوزه هوش مصنوعی و مخابرات، رویداد MotoGP با حضور رکوردی تماشاگران، و نقش ادامه‌دار قطر به‌عنوان میانجی میان آمریکا و ایران. لحن GDELT (۰.۱۴-) از میانگین جهانی منفی‌تر کمتر است و هیچ نشانه‌ای از بحران دیده نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 该时期以例行性正面进展为主：多哈MWC26科技大会、人工智能与电信合作、创纪录观众人数的MotoGP赛事，以及卡塔尔作为美国与伊朗之间调解人的持续作用。GDELT语气值（-0.14）比全球平均水平负面程度低，未见危机信号。
summary.ja: この期間は、日常的で前向きな出来事が中心となっています。MWC26ドーハ技術会議、AIおよび通信分野の提携、過去最多の観客を集めたMotoGPイベント、そして米国とイランの間の仲介役を続けるカタールの動きなどです。GDELTのトーン（-0.14）は世界平均よりも否定的ではなく、危機を示すシグナルはありません。

summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από συνήθεις θετικές εξελίξεις: το συνέδριο τεχνολογίας MWC26 Doha, συμφωνίες συνεργασίας στην τεχνητή νοημοσύνη και τις τηλεπικοινωνίες, μια εκδήλωση MotoGP με ρεκόρ προσέλευσης και ο συνεχιζόμενος ρόλος του Κατάρ ως μεσολαβητή μεταξύ ΗΠΑ και Ιράν. summary.ja: この期間は通常の範囲と見られます。戦没者追悼記念日の式典や平和と団結を求める呼びかけが行われる一方、増税を盛り込んだ予算案が示され、大統領の任期制限をめぐって野党関連の行進が計画されています。穏やかな緊張と増税の動きがあるものの、GDELTのトーンは全体的に前向きで、この日は典型的な基準値付近にあります。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 평상적인 흐름으로 보입니다. 현충일 추모 행사와 평화 및 국민 통합을 촉구하는 목소리가 있었으며, 증세를 담은 예산안이 제출되고 대통령 임기 제한을 둘러싸고 야당 관련 행진이 계획되어 있습니다. 완만한 긴장과 세금 인상이 있으나 GDELT의 전반적인 어조는 긍정적이어서, 이날은 대체로 일반적인 기준선 근처에 있습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य प्रतीत होती है: स्मृति दिवस के समारोह और शांति व एकता के आह्वान, साथ ही कर वृद्धि वाले बजट प्रस्ताव और राष्ट्रपति के कार्यकाल सीमा को लेकर विपक्ष से जुड़े नियोजित मार्च। हल्का तनाव और कर वृद्धि, GDELT के आम तौर पर सकारात्मक स्वर से संतुलित होते हैं, इसलिए यह दिन एक सामान्य आधार-रेखा के आसपास है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος φαίνεται συνηθισμένη: εκδηλώσεις μνήμης για την Ημέρα Μνήμης και εκκλήσεις για ειρήνη και ενότητα, μαζί με προτάσεις προϋπολογισμού για υψηλότερους φόρους και προγραμματισμένες πορείες συνδεδεμένες με την αντιπολίτευση για τη θητεία. Η ήπια ένταση και η αύξηση φόρων συμψηφίζονται με έναν γενικά αισιόδοξο τόνο του GDELT, οπότε η ημέρα βρίσκεται κοντά σε μια τυπική βάση αναφοράς.
summary.it: Il periodo appare ordinario: commemorazioni del Giorno della Memoria e appelli alla pace e all'unità, accanto a proposte di bilancio che prevedono tasse più alte e marce pianificate legate all'opposizione sui limiti di mandato. Una tensione moderata e un aumento fiscale sono compensati da un tono GDELT generalmente positivo, quindi la giornata si colloca vicino a un livello di base tipico.
summary.ru: Период выглядит рутинным: мероприятия в День памяти и призывы к миру и единству, а также бюджетные предложения о повышении налогов и запланированные марши, связанные с оппозицией, из-за сроков полномочий. Умеренная напряжённость и рост налогов компенсируются в целом позитивной тональностью GDELT, поэтому день близок к типичному базовому уровню.
summary.ar: تبدو الفترة روتينية: فعاليات إحياء ذكرى يوم التذكار ودعوات إلى السلام والوحدة، إلى جانب مقترحات الميزانية التي تتضمن رفع الضرائب ومسيرات مخطط لها مرتبطة بالمعارضة بشأن الفترات الرئاسية. ويُعادل التوتر الخفيف وزيادة الضرائب النبرة الإيجابية عمومًا في GDELT، لذا يقع اليوم قريبًا من خط الأساس المعتاد.
summary.fa: این دوره عادی به نظر می‌رسد: مراسم یادبود روز یادبود و فراخوان‌ها برای صلح و همبستگی، در کنار پیشنهادهای بودجه برای افزایش مالیات و راهپیمایی‌های برنامه‌ریزی‌شده مرتبط با مخالفان درباره محدودیت دوره‌های ریاست‌جمهوری. تنش ملایم و افزایش مالیات با لحن کلی مثبت GDELT تعادل می‌یابد، بنابراین این روز نزدیک به خط مبنای معمول قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 这一时期看起来较为平常：纪念日活动以及呼吁和平与团结，同时有提高税收的预算提案，以及与反对派相关、针对任期限制的计划游行。温和的紧张局势和税收上调被GDELT总体积极的基调所抵消，因此当天接近典型基准水平。
summary.tr: Dönem olağan görünüyor: Anma Günü törenleri ve barış ile birlik çağrıları, bir yandan da daha yüksek vergiler öngören bütçe önerileri ve muhalefetle bağlantılı, devlet başkanlığı dönem sınırlamaları üzerine planlanan yürüyüşler öne çıkıyor. Hafif gerilim ve vergi artışı, genel olarak olumlu seyreden GDELT tonuyla dengeleniyor; bu nedenle gün tipik bir temel düzeye yakın duruyor.
summary.es: El periodo parece rutinario: conmemoraciones del Día del Recuerdo y llamamientos a la paz y la unidad, junto con propuestas presupuestarias que prevén impuestos más altos y marchas previstas, vinculadas a la oposición, sobre los límites de mandato. Una tensión leve y una subida de impuestos se compensan con un tono de GDELT en general positivo, por lo que el día se sitúa cerca de una línea base típica.
summary.fr: La période semble routinière : commémorations du Jour du Souvenir et appels à la paix et à l'unité, accompagnés de propositions budgétaires prévoyant des impôts plus élevés et de marches prévues, liées à l'opposition, sur la limitation des mandats. Une tension modérée et une hausse d'impôts sont compensées par un ton GDELT globalement positif, si bien que la journée se situe près d'un niveau de référence habituel.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wirkt routinemäßig: Gedenkveranstaltungen zum Volkstrauertag sowie Aufrufe zu Frieden und Einheit, dazu Haushaltsvorschläge mit höheren Steuern und geplante, oppositionsnahe Demonstrationen über Amtszeitbegrenzungen. Leichte Spannungen und eine Steuererhöhung werden durch den insgesamt positiven GDELT-Tonfall ausgeglichen, sodass der Tag nahe einem typischen Ausgangswert liegt.
summary.pt: O período parece rotineiro: comemorações do Dia da Lembrança e apelos à paz e à unidade, juntamente com propostas orçamentais que preveem impostos mais altos e marchas planeadas, ligadas à oposição, sobre os limites de mandato. Uma tensão ligeira e um aumento de impostos são compensados por um tom GDELT geralmente positivo, pelo que o dia fica próximo de um nível de referência típico.

summary.ja: この期間は、ケベメル沖での移民ボートの沈没により少なくとも34人が死亡した深刻な悲劇と、ダカール・ユースオリンピックでセネガルが複数のメダルを獲得したという明るい話題が混在していました。国民議会の解散を巡る議論や否決された財政法案といった政治ニュースと、カンベレーヌでの銃撃事件は日常的な出来事でした。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的です。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 케베메르 앞바다에서 이민자 보트가 전복되어 최소 34명이 사망한 심각한 비극과 다카르 청소년 올림픽에서 세네갈이 여러 개의 메달을 획득했다는 긍정적인 소식이 함께 있었습니다. 국회 해산을 둘러싼 논쟁과 부결된 재정법안 등 정치 뉴스와 캄베레network 지역의 총격 사건은 일상적인 사안이었습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में एक गंभीर त्रासदी और सकारात्मक समाचार दोनों शामिल थे। केबेमेर के पास एक प्रवासी नाव डूबने से कम से कम 34 लोगों की मौत हो गई, जबकि दाकार यूथ ओलंपिक में सेनेगल ने कई पदक जीतने की सूचना दी। विधानसभा भंग करने पर बहस और अस्वीकृत वित्त विधेयक जैसी राजनीतिक खबरें तथा कैमबेरेने में गोलीबारी की घटना सामान्य थीं। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है।

summary.it: Il periodo ha combinato una grave tragedia, il naufragio di un'imbarcazione di migranti al largo di Kébémer che ha causato almeno 34 morti, con notizie positive dai Giochi Olimpici giovanili di Dakar, dove il Senegal ha segnalato diverse medaglie. Le notizie politiche (un dibattito sullo scioglimento dell'Assemblea e una legge finanziaria respinta) e una sparatoria a Cambérène sono state di routine, e il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: За этот период сочетались серьёзная трагедия — крушение лодки с мигрантами у Кебемера, в результате которого погибли не менее 34 человек, — и позитивные новости с Молодёжных Олимпийских игр в Дакаре, где Сенегал сообщил о нескольких медалях. Политические новости (дебаты о роспуске Национального собрания и отклонённый финансовый законопроект) и перестрелка в Камберене были рутинными, а тон GDELT более негативен, чем в среднем по миру.

summary.zh: 该时段既有一起严重悲剧——凯贝梅尔附近一艘移民船沉没，至少34人死亡，也有来自达喀尔青年奥运会的积极消息，塞内加尔报告获得数枚奖牌。政治新闻（关于解散国民议会的辩论和一项被否决的财政法案）和坎贝雷恩的一起枪击事件属于常规新闻，GDELT的语气比全球平均水平更为负面。
summary.tr: Dönem, Kébémer açıklarında en az 34 kişinin ölümüne yol açan bir göçmen teknesinin batması gibi ciddi bir trajediyi, Dakar Gençlik Olimpiyatları'ndan gelen olumlu haberlerle birlikte içeriyordu; Senegal'in birkaç madalya kazandığı bildirildi. Meclisin feshine ilişkin tartışma ve reddedilen bir mali yasa tasarısı gibi siyasi haberler ile Cambérène'deki silahlı saldırı rutin olaylardı. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına göre daha olumsuz.
summary.es: El periodo combinó una grave tragedia, el hundimiento de una embarcación de migrantes frente a Kébémer que dejó al menos 34 muertos, con noticias positivas de los Juegos Olímpicos de la Juventud de Dakar, donde Senegal informó de varias medallas. Las noticias políticas (un debate sobre la disolución de la Asamblea y un proyecto de ley de finanzas rechazado) y un tiroteo en Cambérène fueron rutinarios, y el tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial.
summary.fr: La période a mêlé une grave tragédie, le naufrage d'une embarcation de migrants au large de Kébémer ayant fait au moins 34 morts, et des nouvelles positives des Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse de Dakar, où le Sénégal a remporté plusieurs médailles. Les actualités politiques (un débat sur la dissolution de l'Assemblée et un projet de loi de finances rejeté) et une fusillade à Cambérène étaient d'ordre routinier, et le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verband eine schwere Tragödie, den Untergang eines Migrantenbootes vor Kébémer mit mindestens 34 Toten, mit positiven Nachrichten von den Olympischen Jugendspielen in Dakar, wo Senegal mehrere Medaillen meldete. Politische Nachrichten (eine Debatte über die Auflösung der Nationalversammlung und ein abgelehnter Finanzgesetzentwurf) sowie eine Schießerei in Cambérène waren Routine, und der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período combinou uma grave tragédia, o naufrágio de um barco de migrantes ao largo de Kébémer que matou pelo menos 34 pessoas, com notícias positivas dos Jogos Olímpicos da Juventude de Dakar, onde o Senegal registrou várias medalhas. As notícias políticas (um debate sobre a dissolução da Assembleia e um projeto de lei orçamentária rejeitado) e um tiroteio em Cambérène foram rotineiras, e o tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial.
